fields.summary_ko.0: MSFT's Microsoft 365 commercial cloud revenue grew 17%, but seat count increased only 5%, with the $30 monthly Copilot subscription charge emerging as a key profit growth driver.
fields.summary_ko.1: RBC analysts estimate that if 45 million of approximately 500 million paid Office users adopt Copilot, it could generate approximately $16 billion in incremental annual revenue.
